result.topic_en: Opening of Riemann's Latin prize essay for the Paris Academy, which sets up the general problem of when a heat-conducting body has lines that stay isothermal and states the general anisotropic heat equation with symmetric, positive-definite conductivity coefficients; a later German note in the corner says the submitted essay is in the Academy's archive.
result.transcription:
Die von Riemann der Pariser Akademie übersandte Arbeit wird sich noch im Archiv der Akademie befinden. Die Herausgabe dieser Arbeit dürfte sich (z. B. durch Vermittlung von Hermite) wohl ermöglichen lassen. Pariser Aufgabe. 1.
1

Quaestionem ab ill$^{ma}$ Academia propositam ita tractabimus, ut primum quaestionem generaliorem solvamus,

Quales esse debeant proprietates corporis motum caloris determinantes et distributio caloris, ut detur systema linearum, quae semper isothermae maneant,

deinde ex solutione generali hujus problematis eos casus seligamus, in quibus proprietates illae evadant ubique eaedem sive corpus sit homogeneum

2

Motus caloris in corpore qualicunque.

Priorem quaestionem ut aggrediamur, considerandus est motus caloris in corpore qualicunque. (Quam tamen disquisitionem ad eum casum restringimus, in quo conductibilitas eadem est in binis directionibus oppositis. Tum) si u designat temperaturam tempore t in puncto $(x_1, x_2, x_3)$, aequationem generalem, secundum quam haec functio u variatur, hujus esse formae constat

$I \quad \frac{\partial\left(a_{1,1}\frac{\partial u}{\partial x_1} + a_{1,2}\frac{\partial u}{\partial x_2} + a_{1,3}\frac{\partial u}{\partial x_3}\right)}{\partial x_1} + \qquad = h\frac{\partial u}{\partial t}$

Qua in aequatione quantitates a conductibilitates resultantes, h calorem specificum pro unitate voluminis sive productum ex calore specifico [-in-] {+in+}[?] densitatem designant et tanquam functiones pro lubitu datae ipsarum $x_1, x_2, x_3$ spectantur. Disquisitionem nostram ad eum casum restringimus, in quo conductibilitas eadem est in binis directionibus oppositis, ideoque inter quantitates a relatio

$a_{\iota,\iota'} = a_{\iota',\iota}$

intercedit. Praeterea quum calor a loco calidiore in frigidiorem migret, necesse est, ut forma secundi gradus

$\left(a_{1,1} \qquad\right)$

sit positiva.

methods.what: General heat-conduction equation in an anisotropic, inhomogeneous body (divergence form with a conductivity tensor)
methods.quote: $I \quad \frac{\partial\left(a_{1,1}\frac{\partial u}{\partial x_1} + a_{1,2}\frac{\partial u}{\partial x_2} + a_{1,3}\frac{\partial u}{\partial x_3}\right)}{\partial x_1} + \qquad = h\frac{\partial u}{\partial t}$

methods.what: Strategy: solve a more general problem first, then specialise to the homogeneous case

items.quote: Quales esse debeant proprietates corporis motum caloris determinantes et distributio caloris, ut detur systema linearum, quae semper isothermae maneant,
items.english: What the properties of the body that determine the motion of heat, and the distribution of heat, must be so that there exists a system of lines which always remain isothermal.

items.quote: Quaestionem ab ill$^{ma}$ Academia propositam ita tractabimus, ut primum quaestionem generaliorem solvamus,
items.english: We shall treat the question proposed by the most illustrious Academy by first solving a more general question.

items.quote: deinde ex solutione generali hujus problematis eos casus seligamus, in quibus proprietates illae evadant ubique eaedem sive corpus sit homogeneum
items.english: then, from the general solution of this problem, we shall select those cases in which those properties become the same everywhere, i.e. the body is homogeneous.

items.quote: Disquisitionem nostram ad eum casum restringimus, in quo conductibilitas eadem est in binis directionibus oppositis
items.english: We restrict our investigation to the case in which the conductivity is the same in each pair of opposite directions.

items.quote: aequationem generalem, secundum quam haec functio u variatur, hujus esse formae constat
items.english: It is established that the general equation according to which this function u varies has this form.

items.quote: Die von Riemann der Pariser Akademie übersandte Arbeit wird sich noch im Archiv der Akademie befinden.
items.english: The work Riemann sent to the Paris Academy will still be in the Academy's archive.
